method: Precision check, not ground truth: predicted events on the organizer samples were viewed as start / middle / end frames with the involved tracks highlighted (tools/review.py) and judged against the task's class definitions. Recall is not measured: nobody watched the full videos for missed events.

boundary_fix: failure_to_yield segments were 0.3-1.0 s (foot point on the zebra). They now span 'vehicle enters the crossing' to 'vehicle leaves it' (any part of the ground footprint on the zebra), 0.7-4.5 s on the samples.
